title: Explanation
description: What `explain(input)` returns (RFC §5.4): the compiled, expanded, or resolved form of an invocation, after the wrapper has done whatever it does. Nothing the wrapper does is invisible. `explain` MUST NOT execute the invocation; that is a behavioral constraint the negative fixtures enforce, not something this schema can express.

would_execute.description: The literal form handed to the underlying tool: a command line, a wire-protocol document, an expanded config. Untyped in the RFC (`unknown` in TypeScript), because the form belongs to the underlying tool, not to this spec.
